Semantic intents 1

1✏️ ⚠️ Replace OpenAPI-only long-running-operation extensions with Azure.Core @useFinalStateVia("location"), preserving all six REST contracts while making three operations consistently recognizable as LROs to SDK generators.
ChangeAspectBeforeAfterImpact
✏️ Modified TypeSpec LRO metadata The operations use raw OpenAPI LRO extensions and operation-level polling metadata while already returning 202 with Location and Retry-After headers. The shared TypeSpec helpers use @Azure.Core.useFinalStateVia("location") to represent the same 202 Location-polled REST behavior.
Three generated SDK methods change from basic to long-running

REST breaking changes 0

Downstream breaking changes 1

high

Three generated SDK methods change from basic to long-running

The wire contract is unchanged, but ScenarioConfigurations.execute, legacy ScenarioConfigurations.cancel, and ScenarioRuns.cancel now expose poller/LRO return types and asynchronous completion semantics.

Evidence: Before the change, generated clients treat the three methods as ordinary operations rather than long-running operations.; After the change, generated clients expose Location-polled LRO behavior with typed final responses.; Base/head OpenAPI method, path, parameters, responses, x-ms-long-running-operation, and final-state-via values are identical.
